youtube.title: Hanuman ji apni hi shakti kyun bhool gaye the? 🙏 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Sita ki khoj mein vanar sena samudra ke kinare pahunchi. Sau yojan ka sagar koi paar nahi kar paa raha tha, aur Hanuman ji chupchaap baithe the. Tab buddhe Jambavan ne unhe unka asli bal yaad dilaya.

Bachpan mein Hanuman ji bahut balshali aur chanchal the, aur rishiyon ke ashram mein utpaat karte the. Tab rishiyon ne shaap diya ki woh apna bal bhool jayenge, jab tak koi unhe yaad na dilaye. Jambavan ke shabdon se woh shaap toota aur Hanuman ji ka bal jaag utha.

Katha ka strot: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda sarg 66 aur Uttara Kanda sarg 36.
